infino on the hosted infino platform, queried over its REST API.
Same code as infino-branch, built against the published infino 0.11.2 crate with its remote client: each query is an HTTPS request to /v1/bm25_search or /v1/count (TOP_k_COUNT sends one of each).
Latency is measured end to end from the bench host, so it includes the network and the platform's gateway. It does not measure the engine alone.
Queries are paced to stay under the platform's limit of 20 requests a second. The pause is not counted as latency.
The platform builds and compacts the table itself; it is not compacted to a single superfile.
Same full-text setup as infino-branch: standard analyzer, positions on, text not stored, BM25 with k1=1.2 and b=0.75, table-wide statistics.
Supports +must, plain should, -must-not and quoted phrases. *_FF is unsupported.
